setup: Seat so the handles are just in reach
Thigh pad snug on your legs
Overhand grip, arms long and up
execution: Pull your shoulder blades down first
Drive your elbows down and back
Let them rise slowly to a full stretch
faults: Don't lean far back to finish
Don't let the arms snap back up

notes: Load and unload plates evenly on each side.
Let the arms come all the way back to the stops before you stand up.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
